prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] and [adoption, new_screen] remains mixed: for each, one test won while the other showed no clear effect.
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] remains inconclusive across four tests: one won (+5.5% after noise correction), two lost or were stopped early (-8.4% and -4.0%), and one showed no clear effect (+0.8%).
[finish, redesign] changes tend to be helpful, as two of four tests won (+5.5% and +4.3% after noise correction), while two showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for all winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early, lost, or showed no clear effect, with round 11 as the sole exception.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 83.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 28.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Quick Setup Spotlight: Redesigns the finish screen into a focused spotlight layout that highlights desktop readiness and initial controls. (why: Support emails show confusion around desktop pet controls after setup, and finish redesigns have strong win rates.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Render Waiting Activity Screen: Adds an interactive waiting screen prior to home arrival explaining pet generation progress. (why: The median time in the home wait step is 201s (mean 2336s), creating a long drop-off gap without clear context.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Companion Journey Path Stage Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a visual stage layout with interactive choice cards. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s with 76.2% conversion, needing a clearer visual decision layout.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Quick Launch Walkthrough Flow: Appends a quick launch verification sub-flow to confirm the pet is visible on the user desktop. (why: Support receives reports of pets not showing on desktop or users not knowing how to control them.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Recovery Hint: Adds explicit guidance on sign-in regarding using the correct account to preserve existing pets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Engine Generation Progress Info: Displays estimated time and compilation progress info on the waiting screen. (why: Users spend up to median 201s waiting without clear feedback, risking app abandonments.)
6: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Split Layout: Switches the adoption certificate screen to a split-pane presentation. (why: The adoption stage takes median 89s with 74% conversion; split layout improves information hierarchy.)
7: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Status Readiness Notification: Enables readiness notification and authentication feedback on the sign-in screen. (why: Support logged bug reports where sign-in stalls or fails to appear before authentication completes.)
